finding: Do costly departures identify preferences more efficiently? Effort weighting narrows the constructed set-point intervals but lowers coverage relative to exact unit weighting. At 32 native records, coverage remains 98.26% and future-choice log loss improves by only 0.0090 nats. The direct reader already trails inside its training range and does not worsen after larger perturbations, so the proposed inside-parity/outside-failure account is not established. These are finite constructed-mechanism results.
